summary: Independently reviewed sealed E-ARCHIVE implementation, source pins, integration coverage, and package-test evidence. The requested Linux archive extraction and cleanup properties are supported; the original 397-member Verify failure is correctly distinguished from structural extraction and the source-complete 405-member fixture.

requestedProperties: bounded regular archive and manifest inputs
strict duplicate-free manifest and exact sorted inventory
safe paths and regular tar entries only
duplicate, extra, missing, and digest-mismatched members rejected
gzip trailing and concatenated data rejected
failed extraction cleanup and private-root-only Close behavior

limitations: Review evidence is Go 1.24.0 on Linux/amd64; Windows filesystem behavior and DOS reserved device names were not exercised.
Extraction proves bounded consistency with the manifest and expected source commit, not publisher authenticity or browser observation truth.
The original 397-member archive is structurally extractable but fails Verify because eight pinned source files are absent; the separate 405-member fixture includes them.
